points.point: why the photo disappeared after the caption edit
points.sentence: Fields you leave out of a complete post are not kept, and leaving out mediaUrls removes the post's media.

points.point: what the AI tool should have done when editing the caption
points.sentence: To change the caption or media: pass the **whole `post` object**, not just the field you're editing.

verdict.reason: This entry explains that an AI-tool edit which leaves out mediaUrls removes the post's media, and that a caption edit must pass the whole post.
